# MakeHuman selected graphical sources

The original byte-for-byte source inventory and SHA-256 hashes are recorded in
`assets/manifests/makehuman_sources.json`. There are 14 upstream UTF-8 source
files totaling 3,129,823 bytes. This notice is project metadata, not an upstream
asset or a grant of rights over Sonnheide original content.

## MakeHuman core graphical data

- Upstream: https://github.com/makehumancommunity/makehuman
- Release: `v1.3.0`
- Commit: `1f508f6083b2f823dab15de924b3bde72e08d77c`
- Included: hm08 `base.obj`, `default.mhskel`, `default_weights.mhw`, and the
  original `LICENSE.md` / `LICENSE.ASSETS.md`.
- Graphical data: **CC0-1.0**. The base mesh, rig and weights also carry original
  inline CC0 evidence. The complete original CC0 legal statement is preserved.
- Credits: Data Collection AB, Joel Palmius, Jonas Hauquier; MakeHuman team.
- MakeHuman application code is **AGPL-3.0-or-later** and is not included in this
  selected graphical-source set or linked into the game.

## Selected community clothing

The official asset pack page and the accompanying MHCLO license metadata agree
on CC0 for each of these assets. All nine selected OBJ/MHCLO/MHMAT members are
unmodified original member bytes. Per-member hashes, compressed byte ranges,
CRC checks and download URLs are in the manifest; complete ZIP archives were
not downloaded or hashed.

| Asset | Author | License | Official evidence |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `elvs_crude_t-shirt_male` | Makehuman, edited by Elvaerwyn | CC0-1.0 | https://static.makehumancommunity.org/assets/assetpacks/shirts01.html |
| `joepal_crude_t-shirt_female` | Joel Palmius | CC0-1.0 | https://static.makehumancommunity.org/assets/assetpacks/shirts01.html |
| `cortu_jeans_shorts` | Cortu Johnstone | CC0-1.0 | https://static.makehumancommunity.org/assets/assetpacks/pants01.html |

Four diffuse/normal textures referenced by those MHMAT files are not imported.
The source legacy shader settings are not native-game materials. This source
selection has passed offline structural verification; it is not a complete
renderable character package.

## Offline tool boundary

MPFB is selected as an offline authoring tool, with reviewed release `v2.0.17`
and commit `80919fa4682335c41847f761a4d79dcad4124732`. Its program license is
**GPL-3.0-or-later**; its extension manifest requires Blender **4.2.0 or later**.
MPFB/Blender have not been installed or run by this import and are not game
runtime dependencies. Each exported community asset retains its own license.

Candidate undergarments with conflicting or incomplete license information
are recorded in `assets/manifests/makehuman_candidates.json` and are not
included. No third-party military uniform is included. Sonnheide military
uniform geometry and country-color masks remain original project work.
